cd target && node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | grep "names" | awk -F ': ' '{print $2, $3, $4}' | while read file _ _ _ _ _ _ old_anchor _ _ _ _ new_anchor; do
  old=$(echo $old_anchor | tr -d ';')

cd target && node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs > spec-errors.txt || true
awk -F ': ' '/names/ {print $2, $3, $4}' spec-errors.txt | while read file _ _ _ _ _ _ old_anchor _ _ _ _ new_anchor; do

done

node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
